Great work!
r359 adds more detail to the error that you're getting, it should help
pinpoint the problem. You can also add target/generated-sources/r-wrappers
to your build path and step through R$primitive$sample.java to see if
something is going terribly wrong in the matching of R-language args to the
java method.

Note that the internal sample primitive that you're implementing takes the
length of the vector (integer) as it's first argument, maybe the problem
lies there? The R-language wrapper the primitive thusly:

.Internal(sample(length(x), size, replace, prob))

For more information:
http://code.google.com/p/renjin/source/detail?r=358
